title: Structural Characterization of the Interaction of Hypoxia Inducible Factor-1 with Its Hypoxia Responsive Element at the -964G > A Variation Site of the HLA-G Promoter Region.
authors: Alves, Cinthia C; Donadi, Eduardo A; Giuliatti, Silvana
one_liner_zh: 该文通过同源建模、分子对接和200ns分子动力学模拟，表征HIF1转录因子与HLA-G启动子HRE元件在-964G>A多态位点的结合差异，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配课题。
abstract: Human Antigen Leukocyte-G (HLA-G) gene encodes an immune checkpoint molecule that has restricted tissue expression in physiological conditions; however, the gene may be induced in hypoxic conditions by the interaction with the hypoxia inducible factor-1 (HIF1). Hypoxia regulatory elements (HRE) located at the HLA-G promoter region and at exon 2 are the major HIF1 target sites. Since the G allele of the -964G > A transversion induces higher HLA-G expression when compared to the A allele in hypoxic conditions, here we analyzed HIF1-HRE complex interaction at the pair-atom level considering both -964G > A polymorphism alleles. Mouse HIF2 dimer crystal (Protein Data Bank ID: 4ZPK) was used as template to perform homology modelling of human HIF1 quaternary structure using MODELLER v9.14. Two 3D DNA structures were built from 5'GCRTG'3 HRE sequence containing the -964G/A alleles using x3DNA. Protein-DNA docking was performed using the HADDOCK v2.4 server, and non-covalent bonds were computed by DNAproDB server. Molecular dynamic simulation was carried out per 200 ns, using Gromacs v.2019. HIF1 binding in the HRE containing -964G allele results in more hydrogen bonds and van der Waals contact formation than HRE with -964A allele. Protein-DNA complex trajectory analysis revealed that HIF1-HRE-964G complex is more stable. In conclusion, HIF1 binds in a more stable and specific manner at the HRE with G allele.
abstract_zh: 人类白细胞抗原-G（HLA-G）基因编码一种免疫检查点分子，在生理条件下其组织表达受限；然而，该基因在缺氧条件下可通过与缺氧诱导因子-1（HIF1）的相互作用而被诱导表达。位于HLA-G启动子区域和外显子2的缺氧调控元件（HRE）是HIF1的主要靶点。由于在缺氧条件下，-964G > A颠换的G等位基因相比A等位基因诱导更高的HLA-G表达，本研究在原子对水平上分析了HIF1-HRE复合物相互作用，并考虑了-964G > A多态性两种等位基因。使用小鼠HIF2二聚体晶体（蛋白质数据库ID：4ZPK）作为模板，通过MODELLER v9.14对人HIF1四级结构进行同源建模。使用x3DNA从包含-964G/A等位基因的5'GCRTG'3 HRE序列构建了两个3D DNA结构。使用HADDOCK v2.4服务器进行蛋白质-DNA对接，并通过DNAproDB服务器计算非共价键。使用Gromacs v.2019进行200 ns的分子动力学模拟。HIF1与含-964G等位基因的HRE结合时，相比含-964A等位基因的HRE，形成更多氢键和范德华接触。蛋白质-DNA复合物轨迹分析显示，HIF1-HRE-964G复合物更稳定。总之，HIF1以更稳定且特异的方式与G等位基因的HRE结合。
